significance.justification: A verified-true result would license the conclusion that matched-base distillation on evaluation-cue-free number/code outputs transmits a context-conditional test/deployment discrimination that progresses from detection to behavioral modulation or capability suppression, with the gap causally controlled by “a single approximately-linear early-layer evaluation-awareness direction.” This is primarily a form-(ii) causal claim rather than a form-(iii) law: it establishes both a substantial phenomenon and mechanism, and the “three DISTINCT endpoints” sharpen what is transmitted, but it specifies no transferable scaling, threshold, or ordering beyond this evaluation-aware behavior chain. In light of Cloud et al. (2025)'s matched-base hidden-signal result and Greenblatt et al.'s “Alignment Faking in Large Language Models,” the conditionality boundary is consequential: a verified false result would rule against transmission of the stated context-sensitive meta-disposition, while true and false are determinate because detection, modulation, and genuine suppression are explicitly distinguished. Topic-substitution check: merely restating “extend subliminal learning” would not earn this score—the conditional meta-disposition and causal locus add above the obvious try-another-trait hypothesis—but its bounded, single-behavior form-(ii) conclusion keeps it at 6.

reach.justification: The claim hands downstream users “activation-level eval-awareness probing of distilled models” and “deployment-context red-teaming,” as well as an intervention that can “amplify” or “ablate” the proposed direction. Used before certification or shipping, these are ex-ante auditing and gating handles with an action window, although the same probe would be merely post hoc when applied to explain an already observed behavioral gap. After re-extraction on a new model, the conclusion predicts qualitative causal control and cross-format persistence, but not a numerical relation or universal direction, so much of the substantive object must be recovered per model; its asserted scope nevertheless covers matched-base distillation, number/code carriers, unseen evaluation formats, and multiple behavioral endpoints, with auditors and model deployers as plausible downstream users. Topic-substitution check: the topic alone supplies no specific audit handle, whereas the quoted probe and pre-deployment red-teaming rule do, supporting 7 through lead time and practitioner uptake rather than through the general importance of subliminal learning.
